readBy: studio/scripts/check-venue-copy.mjs, registered in package.json 'test' and therefore blocking in .github/workflows/ci.yml and verify.yml
notes: This file is the single source. The pack renders it and the check enforces it, so the two cannot drift.
A rule with claimOnly:true is skipped on a line that ends in a question mark. A question is not a claim, and a FAQ has to be able to ask the question it answers.
A rule with copyOnly:true is skipped on a surface whose kind is 'code'. Identifiers, column names and MetricValue states are not front-facing copy.

Surface scope 'blockquote' means only markdown blockquote lines are checked. In an evidence document the copy is what is inside the quote; the prose around it is the rule, and a rule has to be able to name the word it forbids.
Surface scope 'file' checks every line. Punctuation rules never run on scope 'file' because source code is full of exclamation marks and no-break-space arithmetic that are not copy.

Corrected 2026-08-03 (R-042 / WP-16). Nothing read this file until that date. The readBy field named check-venue-edition-contract.mjs, which contains no reference to it and never did. The reader now exists and is named above, and the pinned counts are the first ones any machine has produced in this repository.

rules.rule: D-033 / R-042 / E12.04 banned programme terms
rules.why: D-033 retired "founding partner" on 2026-08-03. The programme is the Founding 25 and a member of it is a founding venue. Partner, member and investor each describe standing the agreement does not create; exclusive contradicts twenty-five venues competing in one region; certified is a claim nobody can hand over. Guaranteed and the permanence set (for life, forever, in perpetuity, lifetime) are already covered by p1-permanence and are deliberately not duplicated here.
rules.substitute: the Founding 25 for the programme, a founding venue for a member of it
rules.patternNote: Deliberately bare rather than compound. R-042 was found nine months late precisely because nothing looked for the bare word, only for the phrase somebody had already thought of. Ordinary-English uses are handled by the exceptions array, which is per surface, per rule, carries a written reason and an exact expected count, and is reviewable in one place.

citationNote: A line that forbids a word is not a line that uses it, and a voice guard listing the banned register has to be able to list it.

Every exemption is explicit. There is no heuristic. The first version of this guard was a heuristic (a quoted match on a line carrying a prohibition word) and it suppressed two REAL defects on the live venues page, because ordinary copy is full of 'no' and 'not'.
Each entry names its line by a distinctive substring, never by a line number. Reword the line and the exemption stops matching and the hit comes back, which is the correct failure direction.
The check prints the citation count per surface on every run, so an exemption cannot be quiet.

exceptionNote: An exception is not a citation. A citation says the line forbids the word. An exception says the word is ordinary English here and means something other than the thing the rule bans.

This exists because a check that cannot express 'partner' meaning a spouse, or a university partner cohort, is a check that gets disabled inside a week. The bare pattern is the point; the exception is what makes the bare pattern survivable.
Every entry is per surface and per rule, names its line by a distinctive substring rather than a line number, carries a written reason, and declares an exact expected count.

An exception that suppresses a different number of hits than it declares FAILS the check, in both directions. Too many means it is reaching lines nobody reviewed it against; too few means the line moved and the entry is dead weight waiting to cover something else.

Known limitation, recorded rather than hidden: the brand collateral index pages are single-line HTML, so on those files a substring exemption is effectively file-wide for its rule. No exception is currently written against one, and the three of them are pinned at zero.
